title: 第27章 沙虫粥
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
赵玉兰以为听错了，惊恐地看着婆婆。

    蔡老太却已经给孩子们做起了示范。

    沙滩上全是密密麻麻的洞眼，甚至都不用找，直接开挖就行了。

    蔡老太提了小半桶海水，挖出沙虫来涮涮丢进另外一个水桶里，无缝对接又能挖出来第二条。

    苗苗和铁蛋撅着腚也跟着挖挖挖，速度同样也不慢。

    边上的赵玉兰看到连芽芽小手都在扒拉扒拉，也就磨磨蹭蹭的走过来。

    她看一眼红彤彤的沙虫真是要昏过去，闭着眼睛挖出一条，那软乎乎的触感更是心惊。

    眼瞅着婆婆挖沙虫就跟打苍蝇一样快狠准，赵玉兰只能咬着牙跟着一起挖。

    挖多了还真就麻木了。

    她蹲久了，偶尔起身就眼冒金星，干脆一屁股坐在滩涂上。

    蔡老太和孩子们都坐了好一会了，只有换地儿的时候才挪下腚。

    苗苗还记得带盐巴来了的，也不管需不需要，反正带来了就得用上，小手费劲地掰扯盐巴块。

    海盐没有抗结剂，硬起来是真硬，小孩吃奶力气都给使出来了。

    真是满滩涂的沙虫啊，反正三孩子玩中带挖，婆媳俩也没赶工，没一会就已经小半桶了。

    蔡老太吩咐儿媳妇停手，“也有四五斤了，我领着孩子回去，你上哨所拿两斤大米，要是瞧见糯米就登记二两一块拿回来煮粥。”

    她们是魏建业的家属，粮油关系一并转到了所里头，平日想开小灶拿粮食时登记就行。

    赵玉兰应了，边把卷到膝盖的裤腿往下放边朝哨所走。

    她特意回头看看，发现三个孩子里没一个跟上的，和之前婆婆去上厕所都得跟的场面立刻就区别开了。

    三个孩子兴奋劲还没过，以至于跑到家门口时，哨所的人以为他们弄了什么惊为天人的好东西，一个个探头去看，下巴差点都惊掉了。

    驻守海岛那么多年，他们从来没有想过挖沙虫来吃。

    海岛上各种鲍鱼海参螃蟹海虾都吃不过来，吃这恶心玩意干嘛啊？

    等会儿得吃虫子还不算，这一个个的看到魏建业招呼他们过去洗沙虫时，眼神更是凄凉。

    这会赵玉兰搂着米袋子已经回来了，忙说：“放着我洗。”
content_en:
Zhao Yulan thought she heard wrongly and looked at her mother-in-law in horror.

    Mrs. Cai has already set an example for the children.

    The beach is full of holes. You don’t even need to look for them, just dig them out.

    Mrs. Cai carried a small half bucket of sea water, dug out the sandworms, rinsed them and threw them into another bucket. She was able to dig out the second one seamlessly.

    Miao Miao and Tiedan stuck their butts out and followed suit, and the speed was not slow either.

    Zhao Yulan on the side saw that even Ya Ya's little hands were scratching and pulling, so she walked over slowly.

    She almost fainted when she took one look at the red sandworms. She dug one out with her eyes closed, and the soft touch was even more frightening.

    Seeing her mother-in-law digging for sandworms as quickly and accurately as swatting flies, Zhao Yulan could only grit her teeth and dig along.

    If you dig too much, it will really make you numb.

    She squatted for a long time, and when she stood up occasionally, she would see stars in her eyes, so she simply sat down on the beach.

    Mrs. Cai and the children sat there for a long time, only moving down when the floor was changed.

    Miaomiao still remembered that she had brought salt, and she didn't care whether she needed it or not. She had to use it anyway, so she struggled to break off the salt pieces with her little hands.

    Sea salt has no anti-caking agent, and it is so hard that the child has to exert all his strength to feed it.

    The tidal flat was really full of sandworms. Anyway, the three children were digging while playing, and the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law didn't rush to work. After a while, the bucket was already half full.

    Mrs. Cai told her daughter-in-law to stop, "There are already four or five kilograms. I will take the children back. You go to the post to get two kilograms of rice. If you see glutinous rice, register it and take it back to make porridge."

    They are Wei Jianye's family members, and their grain and oil relations have been transferred to the institute. They can just register when they want to open a small stove to get grain.

    Zhao Yulan complied and put her trouser legs rolled up to her knees down while walking towards the outpost.

    She looked back specifically and found that none of the three children were following her. This was immediately different from the previous scene where her mother-in-law had to follow her when she went to the toilet.

    The three children were so excited that when they ran to the door of their house, the people at the outpost thought they had found something amazing. They poked their heads to look at it one by one, and their jaws almost dropped in shock.

    They had been stationed on the island for so many years, but they had never thought of digging up sandworms to eat.

    You can’t eat all kinds of abalone, sea cucumber, crab and shrimp on the island. Why eat such disgusting things?

    Not only will they have to eat worms later, but when they saw Wei Jianye beckoning them over to wash the sand worms, their eyes were even more desolate.

    At this moment, Zhao Yulan came back with the rice bag in her arms and said hurriedly: "Let me wash it."
